main.description: A user-curated list of media items (e.g. a reading/watch list).

ordered.description: Whether items in this list have a meaningful display order.

listType.description: Category of list (e.g. to_read_books, currently_reading_books, custom).

visibility.description: Visibility of the list: public or private. Defaults to public. (Collective Social extension field, not part of the base popfeed schema.)

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default inbox list. Only one per user, cannot be deleted. (Collective Social extension field.)

parentListUri.description: Optional reference to a parent list for nested/sub-lists. (Collective Social extension field.)

avatar.description: Optional avatar image for the list. (Collective Social extension field.)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this list was created
